name: Central Sector Scholarship (via National Scholarship Portal)
benefit: College scholarship for eligible students - check the current amount on the official portal.
deadline: Set every year on the portal - check the current deadline before applying.
notes: A Class 12 merit cut-off also applies - confirm the exact rule on the official portal.

rules.label: Family income at most Rs 4.5 lakh per year

name: PM-KISAN (income support for farmer families)
benefit: Income support for eligible farmer families - check the current amount and installments on the official portal.
deadline: Registration is open through the year - check the portal.
notes: Some categories of landholders are excluded - confirm the exclusion list on the official portal.

name: PMFBY crop insurance (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
benefit: Insurance cover for notified crops against listed risks.
deadline: Localized losses (hailstorm, landslide, inundation, cloudburst, lightning fire): report within 72 hours via the Crop Insurance app, the 14447 helpline, your bank or the agriculture office. Enrolment cut-off dates are set per season - check the portal.
notes: The crop you sow must match the crop you insured, or the claim can be rejected.
documents: Land record (7/12 in Maharashtra) or tenancy proof
